To determine whether the plan satisfies the constraint, let's calculate the implied finish time for each week and compare it with the target time.

**Target time:** 0:56:40, which is equal to $(56 \times 60) + 40 = 3400$ seconds.
**Allowed difference:** within 50 seconds (i.e., implied finish time between 3350 seconds and 3450 seconds inclusive).

**Calculations per week (Distance = 10 km):**
*   **Week 1:** Pace 5:41 per km $\rightarrow 5 \text{ min} \times 60 + 41 \text{ sec} = 341 \text{ sec/km}$.
    *   Implied finish time = $10 \text{ km} \times 341 \text{ sec/km} = 3410$ seconds (0:56:50).
    *   Difference from target = $|3410 - 3400| = 10$ seconds. (Satisfies $\le 50$ seconds)
*   **Week 2:** Pace 5:44 per km $\rightarrow 5 \text{ min} \times 60 + 44 \text{ sec} = 344 \text{ sec/km}$.
    *   Implied finish time = $10 \text{ km} \times 344 \text{ sec/km} = 3440$ seconds (0:57:20).
    *   Difference from target = $|3440 - 3400| = 40$ seconds. (Satisfies $\le 50$ seconds)
*   **Week 3:** Pace 5:39 per km $\rightarrow 5 \text{ min} \times 60 + 39 \text{ sec} = 339 \text{ sec/km}$.
    *   Implied finish time = $10 \text{ km} \times 339 \text{ sec/km} = 3390$ seconds (0:56:30).
    *   Difference from target = $|3390 - 3400| = 10$ seconds. (Satisfies $\le 50$ seconds)
*   **Week 4:** Pace 5:41 per km $\rightarrow 3410$ seconds.
    *   Difference from target = 10 seconds. (Satisfies $\le 50$ seconds)
*   **Week 5:** Pace 5:39 per km $\rightarrow 3390$ seconds.
    *   Difference from target = 10 seconds. (Satisfies $\le 50$ seconds)

Every single week has an implied finish time within 50 seconds of the target time. Therefore, the plan satisfies the constraint.

Constraint: the implied finish time of a week is the distance of 10 km multiplied by that week's pace per kilometre, rounded to the nearest whole second (a half second rounds up). A week satisfies the constraint if its implied finish time is within 50 seconds of the target time; a difference of exactly 50 seconds satisfies it. A week violates it if the difference is more than 50 seconds. The plan violates the constraint if at least one week violates it.
Verdict: satisfied
